name: auto-model-router
description: A transparent, boundary-gated policy that routes each coding-agent task to the lightest sufficient model or effort tier (fast, standard, reasoning, or max).

interface.shortDescription: Suggest a model/effort tier; auto-continue clear work, confirm at boundaries.
interface.longDescription: Loads the portable auto-model-router skill: classify each task as fast, standard, reasoning, or max, show the suggestion, auto-continue clear reversible work, and wait for confirmation at tier boundaries and high-risk actions. Does not change vendor billing APIs or guarantee savings.
